mentions.name: Gordon
mentions.description: A security platform that gives companies one place to see their risk, catch threats, test what breaks, track vendors, and train people, with the goal of passing audits faster, lowering cyber insurance premiums, and reducing security fire drills.
mentions.problem: Most companies “have security” but no idea what their actual risk is.
mentions.audience: Companies that need a clearer view of their actual security risk, faster audits, and lower cyber insurance premiums.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building Gordon (https://trygordon.ai/) because most companies “have security” but no idea what their actual risk is. 
We’re building a platform that helps you pass audits faster, lower cyber insurance premiums, and makes cyber less of a fire drill.

Its like one place to see risk, catch threats, test what breaks, track vendors, train people, and not get hacked at 2 AM.
